articles.title: Kidnapping Plot Exposed: Meerut Mother Jailed After ‘Abducting’ Her Own Son to Frame Lover!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut: In a sensational revelation, Meerut Police have uncovered a staged kidnapping case in which a woman falsely accused her neighbour and former lover of abducting her 10-year-old son.

body.html:
Meerut: In a sensational revelation, Meerut Police have uncovered a staged kidnapping case in which a woman falsely accused her neighbour and former lover of abducting her 10-year-old son. The child was safely recovered from Noida, and the woman, Sonia, along with her associate Sanjay, has been sent to jail.

According to police, Sonia, a resident of Dabthua village under Sardhana police station, lodged a complaint on 20 November alleging that her son had been kidnapped by four youths—Mohit, Rohit, Satendra alias Sahendri, and Subhash. FIR No. 781/25 under Section 140(1) BNS was registered, and three teams were formed to trace the boy.

During the investigation, several discrepancies emerged. CCTV cameras at Sonia’s house were switched off before the incident, and her mobile phone records showed frequent contact with suspicious numbers. Surveillance teams later traced the child’s location to Noida, where he was found living with Sonia’s acquaintance Sanjay. Both Sonia and Sanjay were arrested.

Police officers revealed that Sonia had been pressuring her neighbour Mohit to marry her after an alleged affair. When he refused, she had previously filed a rape case against him, leading to his imprisonment. Sonia later withdrew her statement in court after reportedly receiving money from Mohit’s family. After Mohit’s release, she again demanded money. When the family declined, Sonia allegedly conspired with Sanjay to send her son away and implicate Mohit and others in a kidnapping case to extort money.

Following the child’s rescue, Mohit’s mother filed an extortion case against Sonia and Sanjay. SP Rural Abhijeet Kumar confirmed that the woman orchestrated the entire plot for financial gain and to frame Mohit. Both accused have been jailed, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Poison Plot Backfires: Married Woman Dies After Consuming Poison Allegedly Given by Lover in Amroha
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Amroha, UP, a tragic twist unfolded in an alleged love affair after a married woman died from consuming the very poison her lover had reportedly given her to kill her husband.

body.html:
In Amroha, UP, a tragic twist unfolded in an alleged love affair after a married woman died from consuming the very poison her lover had reportedly given her to kill her husband.

A video surfaced before her death, where she claims the youth from her village pressured her to murder her husband and tortured her so much that she ended her own life.

Police say a postmortem was conducted on 21.11.2025, and a case has been registered at Saidangali Police Station. Further legal action is underway, and the law & order situation remains normal.

articles.title: Student Run Over in Greater Noida Society — CCTV Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Greater Noida’s Ajnara Homes Society witnessed a frightening moment when a student, running to the gate with his sister, slipped and was run over by a cab from behind. The child luckily escaped major injuries.

body.html:
Greater Noida’s Ajnara Homes Society witnessed a frightening moment when a student, running to the gate with his sister, slipped and was run over by a cab from behind.

The child luckily escaped major injuries. The entire incident, caught on CCTV, shows the student slipping just before the cab’s front wheel ran over him. The November 19 video is now viral.

The family hasn’t filed a complaint, and police confirm no complaint has been received the matter will be investigated as soon as a complaint is received.

articles.title: Mother Sells 7-Day-Old Baby for ₹6 Lakh — Shocking Child Trafficking Racket Busted in Karimnagar!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | In Hyderabad woman sold her 7 day old baby boy for ₹6 lakh in Karimnagar. Police say she was abandoned by her partner (ex-boyfriend) and claimed she couldn’t afford to raise the newborn.

body.html:
#InShort | In Hyderabad woman sold her 7 day old baby boy for ₹6 lakh in Karimnagar. Police say she was abandoned by her partner (ex-boyfriend) and claimed she couldn’t afford to raise the newborn.

Cops tracked the baby to a couple in Ganneruvaram after a tip-off to the Child Welfare Committee. Over 15 people — including the mother, buyers & middlemen — booked. Investigation on.

* * *

A shocking case of child trafficking has emerged from Karimnagar district, Telangana, where a Hyderabad-based woman allegedly sold her seven-day-old baby boy for ₹6 lakh. According to Karimnagar Town 2 Police, the woman was in a relationship with a man who later abandoned her, leaving her pregnant.

Police said that after giving birth, the woman claimed she did not have the financial means to raise the newborn and decided to sell the child. CCTV footage showing her carrying the infant has surfaced and gone viral on social media.

Investigators revealed that the woman approached middlemen for help, and with the involvement of 12 intermediaries, the baby was allegedly sold to a couple — Bamandla Rayamalla and his wife Latha — from Chakalivanipalle village in Ganneruvaram mandal.

The case came to light after the Child Welfare Committee received information about the sale. Acting on the tip-off, police traced the newborn and shifted him to a mother-and-child care centre. A case has been registered against more than 15 people, including the mother, the buyers, and the middlemen. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: UP Car Driver Fined ₹10,000 for Blocking Ambulance Carrying Critical Patient
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shahjahanpur, UP — a car driver has been fined ₹10,000 after a viral video showed him blocking a government ambulance carrying a critically ill woman for nearly 6 km, ignoring continuous sirens.

body.html:
Shahjahanpur, UP — a car driver has been fined ₹10,000 after a viral video showed him blocking a government ambulance carrying a critically ill woman for nearly 6 km, ignoring continuous sirens.

Police identified the accused as Indra Pratap Singh and issued a challan under Section 194(E) of the MV Act. Officials say the delay lasted around 25 minutes but the patient thankfully reached the hospital in time.

SP Rajesh Dwivedi urged citizens to always give way to emergency vehicles — it’s a legal and moral duty.

body.html:
CCTV footage from Maharashtra’s Ambernath Flyover (Thane district) shows a horrifying accident where a car rammed into multiple bikes after the driver reportedly suffered a sudden heart attack.

Local election candidate from Shiv Sena, Kiran Chhabhe, was returning from campaigning when the incident occurred. One biker was thrown off the flyover, and the driver along with three others tragically died. Kiran Chhabhe and several others sustained injuries.
